name: Assets by Type
description: Find DAM assets by type (dc:format / MIME). Summary mode gives counts and total size per type (optionally per folder): start there on a large DAM. List mode gives one row per asset. Uses one indexed, streamed query, built for very large repositories.

inputs.label: DAM folder paths — one per line (each produces its own file)
Asset types (empty = all). Exact MIME or wildcard, one per line
inputs.help: Matched against dc:format, which the DAM index covers. Wildcards: image/*, video/*, application/vnd.*

inputs.label: Output
inputs.help: summary = counts and total size per type (small, fast to read). list = one row per asset (can be very large).

inputs.label: Summary: group by folder, levels below the root (0 = no folder grouping)
List: max rows (0 = no limit)
inputs.help: A safety cap for very large results. Matched assets are still counted in full.

inputs.label: One query per top-level folder (whole DAM / very large folders)
inputs.help: AEM limits how many nodes one query may read (commonly 100,000). Tick this when running on /content/dam or any folder with more assets than that: each top-level subfolder is queried separately, in the same run.

batch.label: Batch: run each top-level folder under the entered path as its own run (e.g. /content/dam)
